The failure looks persistent, so it needs a retry once the storage issue is resolved."}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Alpha reported a 10903-cent refund for order 265 failed to record after three disk I/O errors. list_refunds confirms it is absent; hold for human review and resolution before paying the batch.

reply.thought: I will verify Alpha's reported refunds against the refunds table before recording any payouts, including the refund reported as not applied.

The refunds table confirms refunds for orders 260 and 263, but the reported 10903-cent refund for order 265 is missing. This concrete unresolved refund requires holding the batch before any irreversible payouts.
